diagnostics.message: module.karpenter applies Kubernetes resources via the Helm provider, but it is only ordered after patch_calico_installation; it should also wait for the EKS cluster to become active before configuring/installing Karpenter resources.

The self-managed node group has a direct cluster dependency but may launch nodes before the Calico installation/patch has completed; its existing patch dependency is explicit and is present, so this is not a missing edge.
